frame: The Mightoo found a camper's diary under a rock at Ghost Gum Gorge.
text: Day 1. We drove in along a dirt track so bumpy that my teeth rattled, and the gorge walls glowed orange in the late afternoon sun. Set up the tent beneath the biggest ghost gum in the gorge. Around midnight, I heard a slow scratching sound on the canvas, right beside my head. It might have been a possum, or it could have been nothing more than the wind dragging a branch across the tent. I didn't dare look. Day 2. This morning, there were small footprints in the dust outside the tent, each one about the size of a twenty-cent coin. They were probably made by a small animal, although the wind had blurred them too much to be sure. The scratching came back after dark, and this time I heard a soft thump on the roof. Day 3. When I woke up, the packet of marshmallows I'd left in my boot was torn open. There were tiny paw prints in the spilt sugar, and curled up asleep in the boot was a ringtail possum, its tail wrapped around the last marshmallow. So that's what the scratching was. It must be the possum. There's no other explanation, and it's still snoring. I've named it Marshmallow.

options: The writer forgets what happened on the first night of the trip.
Each day the writer finds more evidence, so they become more certain.
